programs.name: phase_matched_level
programs.description: Use when the zero phases remain fixed but the positive daily amplitude changes, especially when whole-cycle scaling is biased by an incomplete current cycle.
programs.assumption: At least 3 of the last 4 observations for every structural-zero phase are exactly zero, and the median of at least 4 phase-matched positive ratios from the current partial cycle predicts its remaining positive phases within 30%.
programs.failure_condition: It fails if the zero block shifts by more than one phase, fewer than 4 comparable positive phases exist, or the unobserved part of the cycle changes level by more than 30% relative to the observed prefix.

programs.name: nearest_cycle_analog
programs.description: Use when recent cycle shapes recur as discrete historical regimes and the observed prefix can identify which regime is active.
programs.assumption: Among historical cycles with a complete continuation, the cycle having the lowest normalized prefix MAE has a continuation sMAPE at least 5 percentage points lower than an unconditional seasonal profile.
programs.failure_condition: It fails if similar prefixes lead to materially different continuations, the current regime has no historical analog, or the selected analog's continuation sMAPE exceeds seasonal-naive sMAPE by more than 5 points.

programs.name: rolling_origin_selector
programs.description: Use when it is unclear whether seasonal persistence, recent phase averaging, or damped phase trends best explain the latest regime; the method selects using only recent historical origins.
programs.assumption: The candidate with the lowest mean sMAPE over at least two recent rolling origins remains the lowest-sMAPE candidate over the requested horizon.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when fewer than two seasonal validation origins are available, when the winning model changes immediately after the forecast origin, or when all candidates share the same phase or regime error.
